ADMIN_USER_ID.description: Original-owner Auth UUID used during local bootstrap and hosted setup.

APPLICATION_DEPLOYMENT_ID.description: Deployment identifier being verified, supplied to the verification tool.

APPLY_LAYER_UPGRADE.description: Explicit apply switch for a reviewed layer-upgrade snapshot.

APPLY_UNILAG.description: Explicit apply switch for a reviewed UNILAG upgrade.

CAMPUS_ID.description: Campus identifier supplied per request or workflow; not a global campus restriction.

CAMPUS_INPUT.description: Reviewed input package path for the package builder.

CAMPUS_NAME.description: Display name for the package being built.

CAMPUS_SLUG.description: URL slug for the package being built.

CI_PRODUCTION.description: Production marker that prevents local development commands from running.

CLEANUP_RUN_ID.description: Exact preview-access run selected for cleanup.

DEV.description: Vite-provided development boolean; not a user configuration variable.

DOCS_PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: Public origin used while preparing documentation screenshots.

EXPECTED_MODEL_PLAN.description: Reviewed model-import plan hash binding pinned assets and the explicit review decision before apply.

EXPECTED_SNAPSHOT.description: Required immutable layer-upgrade snapshot hash before applying.

EXPECTED_UNILAG_SNAPSHOT.description: Required immutable UNILAG snapshot hash before applying.

GH_TOKEN.description: GitHub workflow token used to download an explicitly pinned proposal release asset from this repository.

GIS_BACKUP_EXCLUDED_TABLES.description: Explicit table exclusions recorded by the GIS backup tool.

GIS_BACKUP_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Public encryption key for a private GIS backup; the decryption key stays outside CI.

GIS_IMAGE.description: Pinned local container image for network-isolated GIS processing.

GIS_IMPORT_IMAGE.description: Pinned local container image for network-isolated format conversion.

GIS_JOB_ID.description: Immutable processing-job identifier supplied by dispatch.

GIS_TEST_DATABASE_URL.description: Disposable test database URL; acceptance tools reject production database names.

GITHUB_ACTOR.description: GitHub-provided actor name recorded in the private model-import receipt; never used as a fabricated campus identity.

GITHUB_REF.description: GitHub-provided branch or tag reference; review continuation requires refs/heads/main.

GITHUB_REPOSITORY.description: Owner/repository used for authorized worker dispatch.

GITHUB_RUN_ID.description: GitHub-provided run identifier used in verification and cleanup receipts.

GITHUB_SHA.description: GitHub-provided source revision used in health and verification receipts.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub-provided short-lived job credential; never a browser setting.

GITHUB_WORKFLOW_TOKEN.description: Repository-scoped credential with the Actions access required by worker dispatch.

GITLEAKS_ENABLE_UPLOAD_ARTIFACT.description: CI disables upload of secret findings.

IMPORT_RETENTION_ENABLED.description: Explicit repository-variable opt-in to import retention maintenance.

JOB_ID.description: Source-refresh job identifier supplied by dispatch.

MODEL_ARCHIVE_SHA256.description: Reviewed portable model proposal ZIP SHA256; every archive entry also requires its manifest hash.

MODEL_INSPECT_ONLY.description: Read-only model workspace audit that requires no archive and performs no remote writes.

MODEL_OWNER_OVERRIDE.description: Explicit audited original-owner review override, disabled by default and bound to the preparation plan.

MODEL_OVERRIDE_REASON.description: Concrete original-owner review reason recorded by the normal GIS decision API; required for an override.

MODEL_RELEASE_ASSET_ID.description: Immutable numeric GitHub release asset ID for the pinned model proposal ZIP in this repository.

NODE_ENV.description: Node runtime mode; local workers reject production.

npm_config_user_agent.description: npm-provided version information used by the runtime doctor.

OVERPASS_SCHEDULE_ALLOWED.description: Explicit endpoint permission gate for scheduled OSM requests; defaults disabled.

OVERPASS_URL.description: Authorized Overpass endpoint override for source acquisition.

PUBLISHED_MAP_URL.description: Stable HTTPS publication origin. The local stack supplies its own loopback URL.

RELEASE_ID.description: Independently reviewed release identifier supplied by dispatch.

RELEASE_OPERATION.description: Authorized preview or publish operation supplied by dispatch.

RELEASE_SUMMARY.description: Review summary embedded in the generated package.

REPORT_RATE_SALT.description: Private salt for anonymous-report rate buckets.

RUN_TOKEN.description: Per-attempt import claim token supplied by dispatch.

SOURCE_ID.description: Source identifier supplied for a single scoped check.

SOURCE_PYTHON.description: Python executable override for independent source-snapshot verification.

SOURCE_REDISTRIBUTION_APPROVED.description: Build gate backed by the source owner’s permission record.

SOURCE_REVIEW_OPERATION_ID.description: Durable source-review operation identifier supplied by dispatch.

SOURCE_REVIEW_RUN_TOKEN.description: Per-attempt source-review claim token supplied by dispatch.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Private server service-role credential; never exposed to Vite.

SUPABASE_URL.description: Server Supabase origin for database, authentication and private storage.

SUPERSEDES_UNILAG_RELEASE.description: Previous release identifier recorded by the snapshot tool.

TURNRIGHT_COVERAGE.description: Opt-in collection of coverage from Chromium acceptance journeys.

TURNRIGHT_DOCS_DATE.description: Deliberate evidence date for documentation capture.

TURNRIGHT_DOCS_SCREENSHOTS.description: Explicitly enables opt-in documentation capture journeys.

TURNRIGHT_GIS_SCREENSHOTS.description: Set to 1 to include opt-in GIS documentation captures.

TURNRIGHT_LOCAL_DISPATCH_TOKEN.description: Random local dispatch credential generated by local:up and kept in ignored runtime state.

TURNRIGHT_LOCAL_RUNTIME.description: Enables the isolated local dispatch adapter; rejected on production hosts.

VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA.description: Vercel-provided source revision reported by health checks.

VERCEL_TOKEN.description: Private deployment credential held in the GitHub secret store.

VERIFY_BASELINE.description: Baseline evidence directory used by the globe verifier.

VERIFY_BYPASS.description: Private deployment-protection bypass used only by verification tools.

VERIFY_ENGINE.description: Browser engine selected by the globe verifier.

VERIFY_EXPECTED_MODEL_IDS.description: Optional JSON array of exact LASU detailed building IDs required by campus verification; omission permits older releases without detail models.

VERIFY_SCOPE.description: Campus or verification scope selected by the caller.

VERIFY_SKIP_OFFLINE.description: Explicit focused-verification override; cannot count as complete offline acceptance.

VISUALS_INPUT.description: Reviewed visual asset input path for package generation.

VITE_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.description: Set only by the isolated local server and configured-build test.

VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.description: Public Supabase anonymous key, protected by server authorization and row policies.

VITE_SUPABASE_URL.description: Public Supabase project URL. Required only for hosted authentication and editing.

TURNRIGHT_LOCAL_RUN_ID.description: Explicit UUID recorded by a manual release operation; identifies only its temporary deployment access and cleanup.

PATH.description: Operating-system executable search path; the isolated manual validator prepends its own Python environment.

TURNRIGHT_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA.description: Verified full Git commit of an immutable campus source deployment; recorded by the release worker and preserved during production promotion.
